title: Blockchain Firms Link North Korea to $6.3 Billion Binance Hack
summary: Bitcoin Magazine Blockchain Firms Link North Korea to $6.3 Billion Binance Hack Chainalysis and TRM Labs have linked yesterday’s $6.3 billion Binance hack to North Korea’s TraderTraitor group. This post Blockchain Firms Link North Korea to $6.3 Billion Binance Hack first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Micah Zimmerman .
